description: Reference history plus 2024-02-05 closing at 151.0 (below DL 157.92) and ten calm days at 151.
explanation: R4 / D24: a completed candle close beyond a demand zone's DL invalidates it, permanently (PS 2613, RB 1627). An invalidated zone is not fresh, so it cannot be a candidate or a fresh zone, however many calm days follow.
title: A completed close below DL invalidates the zone permanently
